purpose: Register the inferential scope of the locked SOSA and SSN confirmatory sample before any model execution.
study_scope: A controlled confirmatory characterization in one hydrological observation application profile, plus a limited set of official W3C SOSA and SSN examples.

locked_sample_composition.epa_status: Deferred before sampling and explicitly excluded from the implemented v1 source pool.

permitted_claims: The study characterizes validator coverage and repair behavior for six controlled fault conditions in the locked SOSA and SSN case study.
The extension tests the previously developed method in a third, standards based sensor observation domain.
The 168 USGS units are independent monitoring locations under the locked experimental unit rule.
prohibited_claims: The sample is representative of all SOSA and SSN deployments or source families.
The sample establishes cross-domain generalization within the SOSA and SSN ecosystem.
The twelve W3C examples form a balanced comparison group against USGS.
The study estimates the prevalence of naturally occurring knowledge graph extraction errors.
EPA data are represented in the confirmatory sample.
reporting_requirements: Report the 168 USGS and 12 W3C composition with the four USGS scenario family counts.
Describe the USGS representation as one adapter and one hydrological observation application profile.
Describe the W3C examples as limited official semantic exemplars, not a balanced source family stratum.
State that EPA was deferred before sampling and is absent from the confirmatory sample.
Interpret primary condition level estimates only for the locked controlled sample and application profile.
Treat any source family or scenario family breakdown as descriptive and do not claim an inferential family comparison.
